description.en: Pili specialists, bakery gifts, market dried fish and bottled Bicolano dishes, from Centro to the bus terminal.

narration.en: Graceland offers frozen, heat-ready pinangat, laing and Bicol express as pasalubong. Its own FAQ recommends an insulated cooler for frozen dishes; ask this branch about stock and packaging for your journey.

sources.title: Graceland: Official pasalubong and travel FAQ

narration.en: Casa Moderna is remembered for pan bonete, a soft bonnet-shaped roll. A 2011 family account describes taking home boxes of bonete and markina; ask about today’s available breads.

narration.en: RPM Pili Nut Candies, listed by city tourism as RPMiranda, is a downtown pili specialist. A 2024 guide names roasted, salted and honey-glazed nuts, pili tarts and coco jam with pili. This map point is approximate; use the 71-B Panelo Building address.

narration.en: At the People’s Mall, the 2025 pasalubong guide recommends dried anchovies and dried squid. Browse the dried-goods stalls and ask about packaging for the journey home.

narration.en: For another pili specialist, the 2024 and 2025 guides list J. Emmanuel’s House of Pili at SM City Naga. Look for pili tarts, bonbon, polvoron, chocolates and spreads. The camera shows the mall; the shop’s exact position is unconfirmed.

narration.en: Finish at the CBD II bus terminal. The 2024 guide places FSJ Pasalubong Sentral at stalls 7 and 8, with bottled Bicol express, laing, ginataang santol and coco jam, plus goods from local producers. The selection marks the terminal; the exact stalls are unmapped.
